Dialogs.Dialog: How are you spending New Year's？
Takane
I'll relax on New Year's Day, then get busy with New Year's visits.
I see. Lots of visits？
Not that many, but it's a bit of a challenge.
Why？
The New Year's gifts are sweets I make myself. Every year I agonize over them...
Every year, huh. Can't you stop？
My parents say I don't have to anymore. But I don't want to.
Because it'd feel like losing, wouldn't it...？
(Does this count as being competitive too...)
Speaking of February, it's Setsubun. Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family do anything？
Takane
We put a charm against evil by the front door, then throw beans, I guess？
A charm？
You don't know？ It's made with holly and a sardine head.
Only Papa throws the beans, so Mama and I are on cleanup.
Who plays the demon？
No one？ It's a ritual where the head of the household drives away unseen bad luck.
The lucky tea we drink after is good too. Hehe, I can't wait.
(Even their Setsubun is classy...)
It's almost that time, huh？ Valentine's！
Takane
...Curious？
Well, sure, as the boyfriend of a girl who's a great cook！
Geez... But don't expect too much, okay？
Huh？ That's unusual, it's your specialty.
Yes... Some store bought up all the topping I planned to use, so I couldn't get any.
Sigh... I need to find a substitute.
(Even great cooks have their own worries...)
Hey, it's almost that time, right？ Valentine's.
Takane
Yes. I have lots of options right now and I can't decide.
So if you have any requests, I'd love to hear them... Hehe.
Anything ▲高嶺＊＊▲ makes is fine！ I'll leave it to you.
Hehe！ I kind of thought you'd say that.
I'll do my best so you'll be happy？
(Ah, can't wait！)
Hey, it's almost that time of year again, right？ Valentine's Day！
Takane
You're looking forward to it？
Of course！
...Let me apologize in advance？ I'm sorry.
Eh!? W-Why？
...It might turn out so good you'll melt▼
Hehe！
(Phew, that scared me... But I can't wait！)
Hinamatsuri's coming up. Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family put out the dolls？
Takane
Yes, of course. We put them out in February？
You put them up that early？
Yes. The custom is to put them out early and put them away right after the festival.
I see. But why？ They're pretty, so it seems fine to leave them out a while.
Hm？
I wouldn't mind if we put them away a little late... I think？ Hehe.
By the way, White Day's almost here...
Takane
Yeah.
Huh... You're not really expecting much？
"Expecting"？ I won't say "pay me back triple," so don't worry？
But, if I had to say...
I put all my feelings into it, so I'm hoping for a return gift like that too.
Hehe, think hard, okay！
(All right. I'll do my best！)
By the way, it's almost a month since Valentine's.
Takane
White Day, right？
Is there anything you want？
No. Your feelings are enough to make me happy. Really.
Really, anything is fine？ Everything I get from you is a treasure to me.
(Argh！ When she says something that cute, I have to try my hardest！)
Almost a month since Valentine's, huh.
Takane
Yeah▼
Huh... Are you expecting a lot from me？
Hehe.
More than expecting... Right now your head's full of the return gift, isn't it？
Yeah.
Which means you're thinking about me all the time, right？ That makes me so happy.
So a gift chosen by you like that... I'm expecting a lot？
I'm looking forward to it▼
(All right, I'll pick with everything I've got！)
It's cherry blossom season.
Takane
Yes. When I was little, I went to see a weeping cherry tree once.
How were they？
It was so big and so beautiful. Like being in a rain of blossoms...
Huh... I'd like to see it.
But that tree is pretty far away, so a day trip is impossible.
I see...
So let's go someday？ Um... when we're a little more grown up. Promise.
It's almost Golden Week. Is there anywhere ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants to go？
Takane
Won't it be crowded anywhere we go？ If so, I'd rather stay home with you...
What are you, a worn-out office worker！
Well？ Good comeback, right？
...I'm not going anywhere with you now. And I won't let you in my house either.
(What!? Why？)
The sports festival's coming up. Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ in any events？
Takane
Yes. Lots.
Figures... ▲高嶺＊＊▲ can do anything.
Hey, if I take lots of first places, will you give me a reward？
Sure thing. Bring it on！
Yay▼ I'll do my best and sweep them all.
(I need to show off a little too！)
By the way, the uniforms changed over.
Takane
I like the winter uniform better.
Really？ Why？ Summer uniforms are nice！
Because I don't want to get tanned.
Ah, that's why...
A reason some boys wouldn't get, since they're happy girls are wearing less, right？
Uh... Well... Um？
...Geez. Don't you dare look at other girls like that, okay？
(I'll be careful...)
July already... Are you making a Tanabata wish？
Takane
We put up a bamboo decoration at home, so I'll hang a wish strip then.
Very authentic. ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family really does these events properly, huh？
Yes, pretty much. My family likes that sort of thing.
Apparently they weren't like that at first, but started caring after I was born.
They even put up carp streamers, though I'm a girl... Next is moon viewing, I think？
Wow, you really do it all... So, the important part, your wish？
That's... with you... No, it's a secret after all.
(Aww.)
Ahh！ I wish summer break would hurry up！
Takane
Really？
Huh, you're not looking forward to it？
No, not really... Once break starts, it's hard to see each other every day.
Yeah, that's true... But we can take longer trips instead.
...That's true. Yes, stay positive.
Exactly！ And please join me for seasonal events. Plenty of swimsuit and yukata events on the list.
You just want to see that, don't you？
Bzzt. I want to see that "too"！ This summer's going to be busy, so get ready, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Okaaay▼
(Time to have fun！)
It's almost beach season, huh？
Takane
Yeah... Swimsuits, huh...
Not confident？ Bikini, tankini, anything, you'll look great, so no need to worry！
I don't know what kind would be good... Will you help me pick？
Of course！
Great. Thanks in advance？
(Would she get mad if I said school swimsuit...？)
Fireworks season's almost here... Did you buy a yukata yet？
Takane
Hehe, all set. Look forward to it？
Sure！ By the way, can ▲高嶺＊＊▲ put on a yukata alone？
Yes. Once you learn, it's easy？
The thing is, yukata are hot. Especially around the sash. So wearing one for a long time might be rough.
Huh... Then if you can't take it, I'll help untie it. That way it'll be cooler...
...Huh？ N-No！ I didn't mean it that way！ I said it with innocent intentions...！
Hmph.
(Aaargh.)
Sigh... Summer's ending.
Takane
What is it？ Sighing like that.
I like school, though？ I get to see you more than during break...
Yeah... I know, but...
Ah, I know. You haven't finished your homework, right？
That might be part of it...
Geez, you're hopeless. Come on, I'll help, so cheer up？
(Yay！ ...But I still don't want summer break to end...)
Harvest moon viewing is coming up soon, right？
Takane
Yes. I've got the pampas grass, so I just need to prepare the offerings.
So that's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s job？
No, Mama and I do it together. The whole family makes the dumplings every year.
Your dad too？
Yes. He thinks it's fun, like playing with mud. Like a kid, right？
Haha. Nice, I'd like to try that.
I hope you can join us someday？
Yeah！ ...Hm？
Hehe！
By the way, the uniforms changed over.
Takane
Yes. The winter uniform really is nice.
Yeah, it suits you.
...Flattering me won't get you anything？
It's not flattery, so I don't need anything♪
...Geez！ You're always teasing me like that.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s all red. Cute.
...Hmph！
(I love how honestly ▲高嶺＊＊▲ reacts.)
It's almost the culture festival.
Takane
Yes. Everyone's so hyped that work isn't getting done. Will we really finish in time...
Only God knows.
Hehe, maybe. Hey, do you think you can make time？
Make time？ I'll take it！ Let's go around together. Like the haunted house. Like the haunted house.
Sure... but why'd you say it twice？
Ah, no. Just thought the haunted house sounds nice.
...Too bad.
That kind of thing doesn't faze me at all. Expecting anything funny is pointless.
(...Is that for real？ Or is she bluffing？)
It's almost skiing season.
Takane
Skiing...
Are you not good at it？
Yes, actually... Not very. I can't help leaning back.
So even ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has things she's not good at...
Of course. ...Nobody's perfect.
Ah, I don't mean perfect is better！ I'm happier when you show me weak spots like that, is what I mean.
Ah...
...Sorry. If we go, will you teach me some tricks？
Of course！
It's almost Christmas...
Takane
Yes. I love the town's atmosphere this time of year. Everything sparkles, and everyone looks happy...
Yeah, you're right.
With you, I think I'll love it even more.
Yeah, me too.
Hehe. I can't wait for Christmas.
(I have to make this a good Christmas.)
It's almost Christmas. Doesn't ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family have a party？
Takane
Yes. But this year it starts late, so it's fine.
Why？
...I worked a little hard on that.
Never mind！ I can't wait for Christmas.
(I have to make this a good Christmas.)
It's almost Christmas...
Takane
Yes. I always liked the atmosphere, but it felt like someone else's story... Funny, isn't it？
Just having you beside me makes me feel like the heroine.
So I'm the prince and ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is the princess？
Hehe. Take me to the party in a carriage drawn by white horses？
(I have to make this a good Christmas.)
It's almost the end of the year... A lot of things happened this year, huh？
Takane
Yeah... Right.
What's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s most memorable moment？
That has to be that, don't you think？
When we started going out？
Our first kiss？
What was it？
Yeah, starting to go out has to be our big news this year.
Yes. I still can hardly believe it.
Huh？ What？
That I'm next to you, talking like this. Not long ago we weren't even friends...
Now I'm grateful to the god of coincidence. ...Let's keep this going, okay？
Likewise！
I guess... our first kiss？
...Yes. They say your first kiss is special, and I think it really will be.
Me too... Hm？ What's wrong？
...Don't look. When I think of it, I feel really embarrassed...
(Feels like it'll be like this forever. Now I'm getting embarrassed too...)
Hm？ What was it？
That's, you know...
...With that face, you know, don't you？
I really don't know.
Forget it. ...You're so dense.
(Even if you say that...)
End of the year already... A lot happened this year too.
Takane
Yes. Let's keep it up next year too？
Likewise！
...Hehe.
Huh？ What？
It's just a feeling, but I think we'll have this same conversation next year too.
Haha, maybe. Maybe we'll talk about our New Year's resolutions？
Agreed. Then let's do that after this？
(Yeah, this is nice.)
It's almost spring.
Takane
You feel that way when you smell plum blossoms, right？
And when you see bamboo shoots and rapeseed greens at the greengrocer.
I see. That's a nice way to feel the season.
Right？ Thinking of dishes to match the season is fun too.
Maybe I'll make simmered bamboo shoots.
(Sounds great. Ah, now I'm hungry.)
It's gotten so much warmer.
Takane
Hehe, it feels like spring, right？
Ah, right. I have to buy some strawberries on the way home.
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like strawberries？
Love them▼ Jam, fluffy mousse... I just eat tons of them.
This time of year, the Takane house is "strawberry hell." Hehe▼
(Wouldn't it usually be heaven... That's how much they have？)
Days are getting longer. Summer's right around the corner.
Takane
Sigh...
Eh？ You don't like summer？
No, it's not that... It's protecting myself from the sun, you know？
When I get sunburned, I turn bright red.
I see. Girls have it tough.
That's right？ Really, I should have started even earlier.
But I'm a little jealous. I'd like to get a nice tan just once.
(I'd kind of like to see that.)
It's full-on summer... Hot. Way too hot.
Takane
At this rate you won't be able to live without the AC, huh？ You'll get sick, you know？
Hm？ Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ anti-AC？
Only when it's too hot to sleep, I guess？ I don't really like it.
What about fans？
I like them. I like going "Ahhh" into them too.
"We... are... aliens..." I do it every year. Hehe.
(I bet I'm the only one who knows this playful side of her！)
The sky's gotten so high lately.
Takane
The clouds are changing shape too. Fall's right around the corner, right？
Yeah. So, what's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s number one fall pick？
Hehe, number one？ Number one is music, I think. Listening, playing piano... I love this season.
The arts, huh. Not food.
Geez, making me sound like a glutton...
Huh？ Am I wrong？
...Fine, I'm just a plain glutton.
(Where did "plain" come from!?)
It gets dark so early now... It's really fall.
Takane
It's comfortable, and there's lots of good food. I love this time of year.
Fall means eggplant, mushrooms, saury, sweet potatoes...
Pears and grapes, and ginkgo nuts！ Don't forget persimmons and chestnuts▼
Fall, the season of appetite. Hooray！
Hehe. You've joined the glutton club too, haven't you？
(Hooray for glutto... Hm？)
It's getting cold.
Takane
I wish it would get colder. Cold enough for a coat.
▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't mind the cold, right？
Yes, I'm pretty okay with it？
Unlike the heat, the more layers you wear, the warmer you get.
Sometimes I wear my coat inside and get scolded. "Turn on the heater," they say. Hehe！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is pretty eco-minded, huh.)
Ugh, cold... It really is midwinter.
Takane
Hot pot every day would be nice. Warms you right up.
Nice. And then mandarins under the kotatsu.
I think ice cream is the kotatsu classic.
Well, it's tasty. But if we're talking seasonal, it's got to be mandarins.
(She only just noticed...)
